chemistry-killer-11.goal: Analyze the principles of Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal (Inquiry) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
chemistry-killer-11.material:
Maka mmeghachi omume $\mathrm{N_2O_4(g) ightleftharpoons 2NO_2(g)}$, concentration equilibrium constant n'okpomọkụ edoro bụ $K = 0.4$ (a hapụrụ nkeji). N'okpomọkụ a, etinyere $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ na $\mathrm{NO_2}$ n'ime arịa atọ ma hapụ ha ogologo oge zuru ezu.
(A) olu 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.4 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
(B) olu 0.5 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.1 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.2 mol
(C) olu 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.2 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
Tụnyere reaction quotient $Q$ na $K$, kedu nhọrọ na-ekekọta nke ọma ụzọ mmeghachi omume na-eme n'arịa ọ bụla tupu ọ ruo equilibrium?

(C) olu 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.2 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
Tụnyere reaction quotient $Q$ na $K$, kedu nhọrọ na-ekekọta nke ọma ụzọ mmeghachi omume na-eme n'arịa ọ bụla tupu ọ ruo equilibrium?
chemistry-killer-11.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Ịgbakọ ọnụọgụ. (A) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.4/2.0 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M. (B) 0.5 L: [N2O4] = 0.1/0.5 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2/0.5 = 0.4 M. (C) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.1 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Ịgbakọ Q. (A) Q = 0.2²/0.2 = 0.2 < 0.4 → mmeghachi omume n'ihu. (B) Q = 0.4²/0.2 = 0.8 > 0.4 → mmeghachi omume azụ. (C) Q = 0.2²/0.1 = 0.4 = K → ọnọdụ equilibrium.
Azịza: (A) mmeghachi omume n'ihu, (B) mmeghachi omume azụ, (C) ọnọdụ equilibrium (c). (Azịza ezighi ezi: Ọ bụrụ na e jiri mole gbakọọ Q, (A) 0.4²/0.4 = 0.4, (B) 0.2²/0.1 = 0.4, ya mere a ga-eche na ha abụọ nọ n'equilibrium n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi.)
